artifacts.summary: Three-phase plan (allowlist entry, both LadderPump edits under a net-zero line budget, full gate) clearing the C16 env_linter unusedArguments debt in LadderPump.lean.

memory_candidates.content: When two mechanical gates can each be satisfied by one of two edits, read the gate source to find which direction of incompleteness is merely advisory. In this repo, check-module-invariants.sh C26 half two FAILS on an in-source @[nolint X] attribute with no scripts/nolint-attribute-allowlist.txt entry, but only prints INFO on an allowlist entry matching nothing in the tree. That asymmetry fixes the edit ORDER: append the allowlist entry first, add the attribute second, and every intermediate commit stays green without needing an atomic-batch commit mode across the two files. The general pattern: before declaring atomic-batch to hide an expected-red intermediate, check whether one ordering of the same edits has no red intermediate at all.
